capacity_recovery.observed: Unchanged full compound Workflow case builder exceeded 8 MiB before protocol controls could be created.
capacity_recovery.selected: Separate compact case successor and semantic commitments, preserving source cases and all existing limits.
not_selected: Changing old profile limits or skipping cases
capacity_recovery.second_observation: After semantic compaction the complete compound model exceeded the predecessor 4096-case ceiling. The private successor explicitly permits 16384 cases in at most four 4096-case native batches; all old profiles remain unchanged.
capacity_recovery.batch_byte_budget: Four native batches require a separately pinned aggregate 32 MiB family budget. Each native batch retains 8 MiB; the old API and all public profiles stay unchanged.

context_expansion: Two directly required sources added after the full compound family exposed predecessor byte and case ceilings; no unrelated discovery.
